text:
satoshi: anyone else wake up to a lone keytar riff echoing down the 3rd-floor atrium at 2:13am or was that just me? :eyes:
elaine: omg YES i thought a synth ghost had invaded the office.
marc: that was me, i was up wrestling with a bug. not me this time. but 2:13am is a very specific timestamp.
riley: heard it from my desk near the plants. sounded like '80s rom-com soundtrack but better. :miamipopcorn:
lina: could be the mythical 'Night Keytarist'. we've only whispered its name in onboarding.
satoshi: we should create a shrine. also is it portable? was it amplified? did it have pedals?
marc: nailed it 3a4 heard 2 chords and then it vanished. like a musical poltergeist.
elaine: @rhythm-bot did you pick up any ambient audio clips from the office mic?
rhythm-bot: clip uploaded: https://audio.redwood.local/kk/1779501239-keytar-clip.mp3 (access: eng-team) :headphones:
riley: replayed it. that's definitely a keytar. and a tasteful chorus effect.
lina: theory: someone from design is testing retro soundscapes for the demo video.
janitor-bot: floor-cleaned 02:20AM by night-shift crew. report attached. no instruments found. :broom:
marc: the mystery deepens.
satoshi: i propose we convert this into lore: 'The Keytar at 2:13'. annual celebration.
elaine: festival idea: 'Keytar & Coffee' morning where the artist can perform anonymously. free espresso for attendees.
riley: anonymous performer gets a tiny plaque on the snack shelf and a pack of enamel pins.
lina: if anonymous, maybe they leave a tiny sticker on the amp case as proof. detective work, but gentle.
satoshi: also: if the Keytarist is out there, drop a PM to me. canoe emoji. (i just love secret culture things)
marc: should we poll the office? quick survey in #random: did you hear the keytar last night? yes/no/maybe
elaine: i'll run it. 3 options: 'Heard it', 'Dreamt it', 'Am the Keytarist' :keyboard:
rhythm-bot: poll posted: https://slack.poll/1779501300 (ends in 24h) :bar_chart:
lina: if the Keytarist reveals themself, i will bake them a themed cake (keytar-shaped).
riley: cake demands must be honored. this is sacred.
janitor-bot: FYI: overnight janitorial team requests musicians leave instruments on low-traffic nights to avoid trip hazards. :warning:
satoshi: noted. secret concerts to remain safe.
elaine: if the person wants to stay anonymous, we can set up a locked box in the breakroom for 'performance tokens' they can drop a sticker into.
ina: (wait i'm not in participants but i wandered in) love this. totally in for Keytar & Coffee. :heartpulse:
marc: also: anyone got an old keytar lying around? borrowing ok.
riley: i have a tiny MIDI keytar in my closet. will bring it for a noon jam if the Keytarist wants a partner. :raised_hands:
lina: @rhythm-bot schedule 'Keytar & Coffee' trial 1pm next Friday?
rhythm-bot: scheduled: Keytar & Coffee (trial) next Friday 1:00 PM in 3rd-floor atrium. invite: #random :spiral_calendar:
